selection: Same frozen 32-protein pilot. Exploratory length ablation added before the original pilot completed; no test scores used. L and 2L maps are nested prefixes of the same continuation, with EOS disabled.

adaptive_rationale.scope: Five short proteins only; this is a hypothesis-generating diagnostic, not a policy selection or a claim about the complete pilot.
adaptive_rationale.hypothesis: Filtering may improve contact choice while increasing early termination; fixed-length controls separate selection quality from stopping.
